CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMER_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_Customer AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM 
(
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId 
    ,BCD.CUST_TYPE AS CustomerTypeId 
    ,SGC.GLOBAL_CIF AS PartyId
    ,BCD.CUST_BRANCH_NBR AS BranchId 
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId 
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM 
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN SYN.GLOBAL_CIF_TABLE SGC ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,REPLACE(SGC.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR,'CBC_Cards_','')) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCD.CUST_NBR)


UNION 

SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId 
    ,BCD.CUST_TYPE AS CustomerTypeId 
    ,SGC.GLOBAL_CIF AS PartyId
    ,BCD.CUST_BRANCH_NBR AS BranchId 
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId 
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN SYN.GLOBAL_CIF_TABLE SGC ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,REPLACE(SGC.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR,'CBC_Cards_','')) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCD.CUST_NBR)


)A

)


SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_Customer FROM TMP_BNKM_Customer WHERE RN = 1;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_Customer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerTypeId
,BranchId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_Customer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TMP_BNKM_Customer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerTypeId
,BranchId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.Customer --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CCD'	
)

,
TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_Customer_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_Customer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
    CustomerEstablishedDate = NULL
    ,CustomerTypeId = SRC.CustomerTypeId
    ,PartyId = SRC.PartyId
    ,ResponsibilityCenterId = NULL
    ,LedgerId = NULL
    ,LedgerAccountNumber = NULL
    ,CustomerNote = NULL
    ,GlobalLocationNumber = NULL
    ,BranchId = SRC.BranchId
    ,CustomerCreationModeId = NULL
    ,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    ,EntityCreationIndicator = NULL
    ,SuspendedIndicator = NULL
    ,CoreCustomerId = NULL
FROM BNKM.Customer TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_Customer SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.Customer
(
    CustomerId
    ,CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,CustomerTypeId
    ,PartyId
    ,ResponsibilityCenterId
    ,LedgerId
    ,LedgerAccountNumber
    ,CustomerNote
    ,GlobalLocationNumber
    ,BranchId
    ,CustomerCreationModeId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,EntityCreationIndicator
    ,SuspendedIndicator
    ,CoreCustomerId
    ,SourceSystemCode
	,SourceCode
	,WorkFlowId 
	,TaskRunId 
	,InsertDttm 
)
SELECT
    CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,NULL AS CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,CustomerTypeId AS CustomerTypeId
    ,PartyId AS PartyId
    ,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
    ,NULL AS LedgerId
    ,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
    ,NULL AS CustomerNote
    ,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
    ,BranchId AS BranchId
    ,NULL AS CustomerCreationModeId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,NULL AS EntityCreationIndicator
    ,NULL AS SuspendedIndicator
    ,NULL AS CoreCustomerId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId 
    ,0 AS TaskRunId 
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_Customer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_Customer;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_Customer_DELTA;

END
